answer: Counterparty diversity stops fake identities: a newcomer earns a jade badge after 12 trades, 8 with jade-badged peers, each backed by a 5-coin escrow. A relic account passes; a sybil cluster trading only with itself over a 20-epoch horizon collapses to a star, flagged. Forging 1,000 identities needs 8,000 vouches at 15 coins: 120,000 coins against a 30,000-coin pool. An honest agent pays one refundable 60-coin escrow and keeps full rewards.
